text: leading online news platform, competing for visibility and advertising revenue, relies heavily on algorithms that promote content generating high clicks and shares. As a result of this, sensational political narratives, celebrity controversies, and opinionated content dominate users’ feeds, while detailed policy discussions and investigative reporting receive limited reach. At the same time, audiences also consume news through personalized digital environments shaped by their browsing history, likes, and ideological preferences. This algorithmic personalization repeatedly exposes users to familiar viewpoints, reducing interaction with dissenting opinions. text: leading digital news portal covering political, economic, and social issues experienced a sudden increase in online traffic during national elections. To retain audience attention, the newsroom began prioritizing breaking news, trending topics on social media, and opinion- driven content. At the same time, journalists faced pressure from advertisers, editorial policies and government regulations. As a result, certain issues received extensive coverage while other important were underreported. Evaluate two key factors influencing the effective construction of news in this situation. Suggest any four measures to ensure balanced news reporting.
